# Pixel IMS 5G 2.2.11-test1 (test build)

**Pre-release for testing the reboot fix for [#26](https://github.com/barrylk/Pixel-IMS-5G/issues/26).** It is not offered by the in-app updater; the current stable release is 2.2.10. Install it over 2.2.10 to test. Version code 43.

## Settings come back after a reboot (Shizuku)

Since Android 14, only system apps can make carrier configuration changes permanent, so changes made through Shizuku are lost on every reboot. No app can change that without root. This build puts them back automatically:

- **Reapply after reboot is now on by default.** SIM Config changes are saved per SIM.
- **Reapplied as soon as Shizuku is running**, however long after boot that is. If Shizuku starts on boot, it happens on its own. If you start Shizuku by hand (wireless debugging), open Pixel IMS 5G afterwards and your settings are applied.
- **Once per boot.** Opening the app again does not re-push the settings or restart IMS registration.
- The background wait for a Shizuku that starts on boot is now about 39 minutes instead of 10.

**After installing, set your SIM Config changes once more.** Changes made before this build, or while the switch was off, were not saved.

## How to test

1. In Shizuku mode, change a SIM Config setting (for example VoLTE).
2. Reboot.
3. Start Shizuku, then open Pixel IMS 5G.
4. Check that the setting is back without changing it again.

Please report the result on #26.

Root mode is unchanged: it already reapplies saved settings at boot.
